component.name: Notepad
component.summary: Write and edit plain text, in tabs

description.p: Notepad edits plain text files, each in a tab across the top of the window, with File, Edit and View menus, the way people who have used Windows expect. Markdown is formatted as you write it.

ul.li: Find and replace, go to line, word wrap and zoom
A font of your choice, PatroneOS Mono by default
Printing, and a light or dark look
A status bar with the line and column, characters, zoom, line endings and encoding
Open tabs and their unsaved changes are kept between sessions, which Settings turns off

description.p: Notepad as a Flatpak, for any Linux, with PatroneOS's fonts in it.
